title: Martha Raye and whether Mae West played New Orleans
summary: He shared a Chicago bill with Martha Raye; the interviewer asks if Mae West ever worked New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Well, I was going to ask some more about Mae West. If you remember, did she ever appear in New Orleans much or ever worked down here?
As I know of, Mae West never did appear in New Orleans to my knowledge.
They made a movie that was supposed to be based on Basin Street.
Yes, but the scenes were not of New Orleans.
No, I thought I wondered if she'd ever had any experience here.
As far as I know, no. She's never been in New Orleans. I knew anything about her. I never heard her mention New Orleans at all. But she's been to all the other cities. I was quite surprised.
